jira_scope: Always ask at run start, in one combined question: which Jira user's tickets to audit, the board name, the sprint (offer the board's active sprint as a choice), and which board column(s)/statuses to include (e.g. Release Pending, In Progress). Never fall back to remembered or configured values.
release_comment: The work has been released to production.
merge_equals_release_when_undeployed: For repositories with no app-interface deployment that are npm package repos or nx monorepos, a PR merged to the default branch is equivalent to a production release.
